title: Alien involvement with Earth spans more than one country

tellings.quote: he did say that it was more than one country.

plain: Contact with aliens is not the business of a single nation, according to a former sergeant named Dan Sherman, who says the NSA, the US electronic spying agency, hired him in the early 1990s to communicate with aliens. Sherman says that a man he dealt with in that work told him "it was more than one country." If true, several governments would share the secret.
